name: Textarea
description: A multi-line text field with a label, an optional hint, and an error message.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, connected to the field.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Marks the field invalid and replaces the hint.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Shows a live character count when set.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All native attributes of the underlying element.

a11y: The label is a real <label> tied to the textarea.
Hint, error and count are linked with aria-describedby; an error sets aria-invalid.
The focus indicator has at least 3:1 contrast against the surface.
